title: 📯  **Her Hans Official Military Music**
description: ACHTUNG! Her Hans is in command of military music. Report to voice channel to receive disciplined marches, recruit!
canvas_mc_description: SCHNELL! Use ze menu to request authorized marches, inspect playback queue, or add disciplined music! No excuses, Zivilist!
queue_empty: 📭 Ze formation is empty! Disorganized recruits!
song_name_placeholder: Enter march name, YouTube URL or order...

dropdown.mc_play_description: Request authorized march and play immediately! No delays!
dropdown.mc_add_description: Add march to ze end of playback formation! Maintain order!
dropdown.mc_skip_description: Skip current march and go to next! March in unison!
dropdown.mc_pause_description: Pause playback by superior order! Discipline!
dropdown.mc_stop_description: Stop playback and clean entire formation! Order restored!
dropdown.mc_queue_description: Show marches in playback formation! Strict control!
dropdown.mc_remove_last_description: Remove ze last march added to formation! Immediate correction!
dropdown.mc_clear_description: Remove all marches from formation! Total void!
dropdown.mc_history_description: Show recently executed marches! Official records!
dropdown.mc_volume_description: Adjust march volume between 0-100! No excesses, recruit!
